name: blast-detonation-sequence-ui
description: Visual verification of detonation sequence UI: auto-sequence, delay labels, color coding

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:5 depth:6 start:15,15

steps.description: sequence set hole:H1 delay:0 — per-hole delay is only reachable via relative +/- steppers ([data-hole="H1"] [data-action="delay-inc"/"delay-dec"]), not a set-to-value click; reaching an exact target would mean replicating Auto Sequence's row algorithm to compute a click count. Left as a command (Finding #9).
